text: This app is ridiculously good. This has been my standard keyboard since I first installed it a couple of weeks ago. I hardly ever type anymore. In my opinion, this should replace Gboard. Here's the thing that would make me really happy, though: when I ask Typeless a question directly, I kind of want an answer. I don't want to be told that it can't help. I know it can; I've gotten answers out of it before. Also, it needs customization prompts; humans don't speak in markdown.
